Feature requests need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there with the proposed `SpeedColumn` API.

Rich has no `SpeedColumn` today. [`TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=...)`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) only shows speed when `total` is unknown, using a fixed `it/s` unit. Related earlier reports: #3835 and #304.

Until then, a custom column that subclasses `ProgressColumn` can render any unit, as [`TransferSpeedColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) does for bytes.
